note_zh: 招牌动作纠错规则预埋：当前以口头 cue 为主，几何/模型阈值待真视频数据后再钉。
note_en: Stub coaching rules for signature moves. Geometry/model thresholds TBD after labeled clips.

rules.feedback_zh: 转身时重心压在支撑脚上，别先抬头找人。
rules.feedback_en: Load the plant foot through the spin — don't look up too early.

rules.feedback_zh: 外侧假晃要骗到防守者重心，内侧扣回要快、贴地。
rules.feedback_en: Sell the outside fake; the inside snap should be quick and low.

rules.feedback_zh: 踩单车节奏要稳，最后一下变向才加速。
rules.feedback_en: Keep the step-over rhythm; explode only on the real exit.

rules.feedback_zh: 垫球与挑球衔接要紧，挑完立刻找落点。
rules.feedback_en: Link the roll and flick tightly; sprint to the landing spot.

rules.feedback_zh: 假传要像真的——摆腿幅度够，再收到身后。
rules.feedback_en: Sell the pass first — big swing, then drag behind.

rules.feedback_zh: 招牌动作先慢后快；热身充分，避免脚踝硬拧。
rules.feedback_en: Learn signature moves slow → fast; warm up ankles before sharp cuts.
